title: A counted mention above a mention-only row makes it a normal unread row with the @
why: On a conversation that is not muted the server counts a mention like any message (rw_inbox_normal_v5 unread_count has no mention term), so the row's unread_count is no longer NULL.

server: infra/risingwave/sql/075-inbox-cursor-decouple.sql (unread_count and latest_seq from one materialized row)
